text:
ITEM 1 | Large white square-ish plate about 26 cm across serves as reference; main pile of pale golden-green flaky rice-like mixture with visible herb flecks and light browning, moist and clumping, roughly 12 x 10 cm footprint, about 3 cm tall, sitting in the lower center of the plate | 280
ITEM 2 | Two pink-orange salmon-like fillet pieces with flaky, moist texture and light golden crust edges, each about 5 x 4 cm, partly covered by the herb-speckled pale mixture, lower center of plate | 150
ITEM 3 | Dark brown glazed block, about 5 x 3 cm and 2 cm tall, with a shiny sticky surface and slightly charred edges, upper left of the pile | 60
ITEM 4 | Cheese-topped piece with bubbly golden-orange melted cheese and browned spots over a pale base, about 6 x 5 cm, 2.5 cm tall, upper center | 70
ITEM 5 | Cooked dark green leafy vegetable, wilted and clumped with some darker crinkled leaves, about 6 x 4 cm, upper right of the pile | 35
ITEM 6 | Short tubular pasta (penne-like), glossy pale yellow with light sheen, scattered in small pieces about 4 cm long, upper right and around the cheese piece | 90
ITEM 7 | Two thin yellow lemon slices with pale pulpy centers and slight translucence, each about 5 cm across, right of the rice mixture | 25
ITEM 8 | Sautéed mushroom-like pieces, tan to brown with moist glossy surface and curled edges, around 3 x 2 cm each, right side near the pasta | 30
ITEM 9 | Small golden-brown cube of fried or toasted bread-like item with crisp edges, about 3 x 3 cm and 2.5 cm tall, far right edge | 20
ITEM 10 | Light sauce or oil residue, thin glossy film with small flecks, pooled faintly around the food on the plate | 10
